name: 2. Simulador de Lote Óptimo (EOQ) y Curvas de Costo

planSteps.description: Click on 'Módulo 1: Simulador de Lote Óptimo (EOQ)' in the top tab navigation
The EOQ game container is visible and displays the Giant Slider and Sawtooth Chart canvas
Click on the preset button 'Caso Golo S.A.'
The optimal batch display shows 1,369 u and the ROP card updates to 16 unidades
